name: herdr-sibling-panels
description: Interactive sibling panels in caller workspace/tab: newest eligible native Agy workhorse at High effort for builder and validator. Designed for Herdr current-pane placement.

agents.name: gemini-builder
agents.task: Own implementation edits; write or run no tests unless the owner explicitly asked. Produce concrete diffs and verified build/check results.

agents.name: gemini-validator
agents.task: Run targeted validation and adversarial checks. Verify edge cases and report concrete findings.

notes: Uses placement: current-pane automatically when invoked inside Herdr (HERDR_ENV=1).
Resolves the newest eligible native Agy workhorse from its current catalog at High effort before launch; exact model pins remain available through model.
Panels are split directly in the caller's active tab without focusing away or creating an isolated daemon.
